description: This file defines the main application structure and behavior for the macOS menu bar app 'OpenClaw'. It includes the application startup delegate, main app scene with menu bar integration, status item handling, user interface components, and update mechanisms. It manages application lifecycle events, UI interactions, and external dependencies for the app's core functionality.

classes.name: StatusItemMouseHandlerView
classes.description: A transparent NSView subclass that captures mouse events on the status item, handling left and right clicks and mouse hover events without interfering with the menu bar item's actual functionality.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: The application delegate responsible for handling app launch, termination events, and initializing core app state and services.

classes.name: UpdaterProviding
classes.description: A protocol defining the interface for app update checking and installation, allowing for different implementations such as Sparkle or a disabled stub.

classes.name: DisabledUpdaterController
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of UpdaterProviding used for non-updating scenarios, such as development or unsigned builds.

classes.name: UpdateStatus
classes.description: A class representing the current status of updates, including whether an update is available or downloaded.

classes.name: SparkleUpdaterController
classes.description: An implementation of UpdaterProviding that manages Sparkle's automatic update checking, downloads, and user decisions, used when the app is signed with a Developer ID.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching
methods.description: Handles the app launch, sets up global state, dependencies, onboarding, and optional auto-opening chat based on CLI arguments.

methods.name: applicationWillTerminate
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks such as stopping background services and closing web chat when the app terminates.

methods.name: scheduleFirstRunOnboardingIfNeeded
methods.description: Determines if onboarding should be shown based on user defaults and version, then presents it after a delay.

methods.name: isDuplicateInstance
methods.description: Checks if another instance of the app is already running to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: installStatusItemMouseHandler
methods.description: Adds a custom view over the status item button to handle mouse events like clicks and hover.

methods.name: toggleWebChatPanel
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the web chat panel, dismissing hover HUD overlays.

methods.name: statusButtonScreenFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the screen frame of the status item button for positioning overlays.

methods.name: effectIconState
methods.description: Determines the effective icon state to display based on app state and activity store.
